SPN - Malawi - Construction of Auxiliary Buildings for Rumphi Water Supply System (Package 2) - RWSSIP
10-Dec-2025
The Government of Malawi through the Northern Region Water Board has received financing from the African Development Bank hereinafter called the Bank toward the cost of the Rumphi Water and Sanitation Services Improvement Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contracts for Construction of Auxiliary Buildings (Package 2) for Rumphi Water Supply System in Rumphi District. 
The Northern Region Water Board (NRWB) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders registered with the National Construction Industry Council of Malawi (NCIC) in the Unlimited Building Category for Construction of Auxiliary Buildings (Package 2) for Rumphi Water Supply System in Rumphi District. The construction period is Ten (10) Calendar Months.
